papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Prior analyses of National Institutes of Health (NIH) funding to radiology departments have characterized aggregate grant volume and funding levels but have not systematically examined the institutional landscape of clinician-led research. This study characterized the institutional distribution of NIH funding awarded to clinician principal investigators (PIs) in diagnostic radiology (DR), interventional radiology (IR), and radiation oncology (RO) from fiscal years 2012 through 2025. METHODS: In this retrospective cross-sectional analysis, grant records were extracted from the NIH Research Portfolio Online Reporting Tools Expenditures and Results (RePORTER) database and filtered to PIs with an institutional department designation of "Radiation-Diagnostic/Oncology." Clinician investigators were identified by cross-referencing with the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) datasets. Institutional funding, grant counts, unique investigators, grant mechanism portfolios, and career development awards were analyzed. RESULTS: A total of 437 unique clinician investigators (DR: 226; IR: 46; RO: 165) were identified, accounting for $1.65 billion in inflation-adjusted funding. NIH-funded clinicians were distributed across 47 institutions in DR, 29 in IR, and 45 in RO. The top five institutions accounted for 34.5% of grants and 38.4% of total funding, largely reflecting workforce size: institutional clinician PI count explained 82% of the variance in funding, and funding per clinician PI was more evenly distributed (Gini 0.38) than total funding (Gini 0.62). Stanford received the largest grant funding in DR ($134.9M), UC San Francisco in IR ($36.9M), and University of Michigan in RO ($68.1M). R01 awards were the dominant mechanism across all subspecialties. Forty new K-awards were issued across 21 institutions. CONCLUSIONS: NIH funding to radiology clinician investigators is concentrated at a small number of academic medical centers, principally because those centers host larger clinician investigator workforces, with a narrow clinician-scientist pipeline. These findings identify opportunities to broaden research capacity across the radiology workforce.

papers.abstract_en: AIMS: Pulmonary sclerosing pneumocytoma (PSP) combined with carcinoid is rare, and the potential pathogenetic relationship between the two tumor components is unclear. This study investigated the clinicopathological characteristics and explored the molecular features common to the two tumors. METHODS AND RESULTS: We collected six cases from three institutions in China (2020-2023), evaluated histopathological and immunophenotypic features, and performed a review of the literature. Three patients displayed spatially segregated dual-tumor lesions, while the other three exhibited intermixed growth morphology. We performed targeted next-generation sequencing (NGS) on microdissected PSP and carcinoid tissue compartments. Genomic profiling identified AKT1 p.E17K across seven lesion compartments among 12 microdissected PSP/carcinoid pairs from six patients. The three patients with mixed-growth lesions (Cases 4-6) exhibited identical mutations in paired PSP and carcinoid compartments, contributing six mutation-positive compartments (6/12). In contrast, of the three patients with spatially separated biphasic lesions, only Case 1 bore the variant exclusively in its PSP compartment, corresponding to the seventh positive compartment (1/12), whereas the matched carcinoid component lacked this variant entirely. After RNA extraction and library quality control, four PSP samples (Cases 1, 2, 4, 5) and three carcinoid samples (Cases 1, 2, 4) were retained; transcriptomic profiling further revealed that, in these eligible cases, the expression patterns of key marker genes (i.e., SYP, NCAM1, and NKX2-1) were highly consistent with the immunohistochemical findings, and that both components shared activation of major oncogenic signaling pathways, including the PI3K/Akt pathway. In these mixed cases, paired PSP and carcinoid components shared AKT1 p.E17K mutations; very few additional somatic driver mutations and copy-number alterations were shared between them. CONCLUSIONS: AKT1 p.E17K mutation and shared PI3K/Akt activation suggest a molecular link between PSP and carcinoid in mixed growth lesions. Further studies are needed to clarify the pathogenetic relationship between PSP and carcinoid.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The importance of perioperative nursing is increasingly being recognized; however, how operating room nurses contribute to patient outcomes remains underexplored, because nursing roles are often not distinguished. This study aims to map outcomes associated with perioperative nursing practices performed by operating room nurses, focusing on outcome types, measurement methods, and timing of evaluation. This review addresses the question of what outcomes of perioperative nursing practices performed by operating room nurses have been reported. METHODS: This scoping review follows Arksey and O'Malley's framework, incorporating refinements by Levac et al., and adheres to the JBI guidelines. A comprehensive literature search was conducted using PubMed, CINAHL Plus, and EMBASE, without restrictions on publication year, targeting peer-reviewed English-language articles published up to May 28, 2025, excluding case reports, reviews, and non-peer-reviewed studies. Studies reporting outcomes related to perioperative nursing practices by operating room nurses were included. Data were extracted and descriptively synthesized, with outcomes categorized by perioperative phase. RESULTS: Twenty-four studies published between 1991 and 2025 were included, with randomized controlled trials being the most common (n = 10). Reported outcomes spanned the entire perioperative period. Preoperative outcomes primarily involved psychological indicators, intraoperative outcomes focused on physiological stability, and postoperative outcomes included pain, recovery, complications, patient satisfaction, and quality of life. Outcome definitions, measurement methods, and evaluation time points varied across studies. Overall, the mapped outcomes varied widely across the perioperative phases, highlighting marked heterogeneity and a lack of standardization. CONCLUSIONS: This scoping review descriptively synthesizes the outcomes used to evaluate perioperative nursing practices performed by operating room nurses across the perioperative phases. Diverse outcomes were reported across studies, reflecting the multifaceted nature of operating room nursing practice. Developing standardized, nursing-specific core outcome sets may improve consistency in future research and support evidence-based practice and education. REVIEW REGISTRATION: This review protocol was prospectively registered with the UMIN Clinical Trials Registry (UMIN-CTR; ID: UMIN000058114; Registration date: June 7, 2025).

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Disasters are increasingly prevalent nowadays, whether it is mass casualty incidents, pandemics, or the growing impact of climate change and conflicts. Nursing students should be prepared to be competent nurses, so that they can react safely and efficiently in the healthcare system. However, research on how advanced technology, such as artificial intelligence (AI)-powered videos, in disaster nursing education remains limited. Therefore, this study aims to investigate the impact of AI-powered animation videos on undergraduate nursing students' knowledge and learning perception of disaster preparedness. METHODS: This study adopted a quantitative design involving seventy-five undergraduate nursing students. A flipped classroom approach, grounded in the Cognitive Theory of Multimedia Learning, was implemented through the use of micro-modules with AI-powered videos and interactive mini-games. Students' disaster preparedness was assessed by using a pretest-posttest approach, with the pretest administered one week before the micro-module and the posttest conducted at the end of the course. RESULTS: Significant improvement in disaster preparedness was shown in the posttest compared with both the pretest and the prior cohort. Students reported feeling confident with self-directed learning (mean scores: 3.88 to 3.99) and satisfied with the content delivery (mean scores: 3.95 to 3.99) and expressed high overall satisfaction (mean scores: 3.93 to 4.01). CONCLUSION: The findings suggest that the integration of AI-powered videos into the flipped classroom curriculum was feasible and effective strategy for disaster education in nursing curricula. By presenting complex disaster preparedness concepts, in manageable sessions, the intervention facilitated significant improvements in students' knowledge acquisition and fostered positive learning perceptions. These findings underscore the potential of AI powered instructional strategies to strengthen disaster preparedness among nursing students and support the development of a more resilient and practice ready healthcare workforce.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Despite the growing workforce of intravenous therapy (IV) specialist nurses in China, substantial underutilization remains a significant challenge. The effective use of IV specialist nurses is influenced by a complex interplay of factors. However, no comprehensive instrument currently exists to assess these factors in the Chinese healthcare context systematically. This study aimed to develop and psychometrically test a questionnaire to assess factors affecting the role effectiveness of IV therapy specialist nurses in China. METHODS: The preliminary questionnaire was developed through literature review, semi-structured interviews, two rounds of expert consultation, and a pilot survey. The final questionnaire was administered to 670 IV therapy specialist nurses from 62 hospitals in Beijing, China, between March and April 2025. Psychometric evaluation included content validity (I-CVI, S-CVI), item analysis, exploratory factor analysis (EFA), confirmatory factor analysis (CFA), and reliability testing (Cronbach's α, split-half reliability, test-retest reliability). RESULTS: The final questionnaire consisted of 17 items across two dimensions. The overall Cronbach's α coefficient was 0.969, with split-half reliability of 0.960 and test-retest reliability of 0.990. The scale-level content validity index (S-CVI) was 0.991. EFA extracted two factors explaining 71.047% of the total variance, with factor loadings ranging from 0.643 to 0.924. CFA produced the following fit indices: χ²/df =3.856, RMSEA = 0.092, SRMR =0.0383, GFI =0.860, CFI =0.947, IFI =0.947, NFI =0.930, and RFI =0.918. The average variance extracted (AVE) values for the two factors were 0.707 and 0.724, and composite reliability (CR) values were 0.960 and 0.948. CONCLUSIONS: The final model showed improved fit, with most indices meeting recommended thresholds, although RMSEA remained above the recommended cut-off, suggesting that the instrument is a valid and reliable tool for assessing factors affecting the role effectiveness of IV therapy specialist nurses in Beijing, China. Further multicenter studies with larger, more diverse, and independent samples across China are needed to confirm its generalizability, and further refine the instrument for broader application.

papers.abstract_en: Breast photoacoustic tomography (PAT) enables noninvasive vascular imaging with high spatial resolution and optical contrast, but most prior studies have focused on static anatomy rather than functional dynamics. We introduce hypoxia-correlation functional PAT (hc-PAT), which leverages the abnormal vascular reactivity of malignant tumors. Participants underwent alternating breath-holding and normal breathing to induce transient systemic hypoxia, monitored by pulse oximetry. Simultaneous hc-PAT imaging was performed, and voxel-wise correlation with the oxygenation waveform generated functional maps. Malignant tumors showed significantly higher correlation coefficients than surrounding tissue, clearly delineating lesions consistent with magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and tumor pathophysiology. Quantitative analysis revealed greater inter-breast asymmetry in malignant versus benign cases ( p ∼ 0.014  ). hc-PAT also sensitively tracked response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy, showing reduced hypoxia reactivity alongside MRI-confirmed tumor shrinkage. This pilot study demonstrates that hc-PAT can enhance breast cancer detection using endogenous functional contrast, suggesting the potential for sensitive, injection-free functional imaging that warrants validation in larger cohorts.

papers.abstract_en: Cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) are integral components of the tumor microenvironment (TME) and are increasingly recognized as critical regulators of nearly every hallmark of cancer. Once viewed as a uniform, protumorigenic cell type, it is now clear that CAFs comprise a spectrum of dynamic and plastic functional states with both tumor-promoting and tumor-restraining capacities. This functional duality, conceptualized within the framework of cancer as a "wound that fails to heal", is dictated by their diverse cellular origins, the specific activation pathways engaged (such as TGF-β and PDGF), and the evolving cues from the TME. In this Review, we dissect the multifaceted roles of CAFs, from their promotion of cancer cell proliferation, invasion and angiogenesis through secreted factors and extensive extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling, to their profound influence on the immune landscape. We detail how distinct CAF subsets, such as myofibroblastic (myCAFs) and inflammatory (iCAFs) CAFs, orchestrate an immunosuppressive niche and contribute to therapeutic resistance. We also explore the compelling evidence for tumor-suppressive CAF functions, which have catalyzed a paradigm shift in therapeutic strategies-moving away from indiscriminate CAF ablation towards nuanced approaches aimed at reprogramming their state. These strategies include modulating key signaling pathways, normalizing the CAF-remodeled ECM, and exploiting unique metabolic vulnerabilities. Finally, we discuss how advances in single-cell and spatial transcriptomics are resolving this complexity, paving the way for the development of precision therapies that can selectively neutralize pro-tumorigenic CAF activities while harnessing their beneficial functions to improve patient outcomes.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) is a common herpesvirus that establishes lifelong latency and becomes increasingly prevalent with age. To systematically delineate CMV-associated immune remodeling at single-cell resolution, we analysed six human cohorts (including two newly established cohorts) using single-cell RNA sequencing, T cell receptor (TCR) sequencing, and flow cytometry. RESULTS: We identified novel CMV-associated changes in cell frequencies, including increases in GZMK⁺ CD8⁺ T cells and atypical B cells, and a reduction in CD56dim NK cells, in addition to the canonical expansion of CD4⁺/CD8⁺ TEMRA and adaptive NK cells. Longitudinal profiling of an individual who seroconverted revealed rapid CMV-driven shifts in circulating immune cell frequencies. Leveraging a recently published CMV-specific TCRβ database, combined with predictive modeling (CMVerify), we identified novel CMV-specific clonal expansions that were reproduced across two independent cohorts. In the CD8⁺ lineage, CMV-specific clones were enriched in GZMK⁺ CD8⁺ T cells and CD8⁺ TEMRA cells, whereas in the CD4⁺ lineage, Th1 cells showed clonal expansion alongside CD4⁺ TEMRA cells. CONCLUSIONS: This multi-cohort integrative study defines the cellular and clonal signatures of latent CMV in humans and identifies GZMK⁺ CD8⁺ T cells and Th1 cells as previously underappreciated components of the CMV response.

papers.abstract_en: Photoacoustic tomography (PAT) is widely utilized in biomedical imaging due to its high optical contrast and deep acoustic penetration. However, the scarcity of high-quality datasets hinders the application of deep learning in this field. To address this, we propose a latent diffusion model (LDM)-based dual-domain data generation framework, which consists of two independently-trained synthesis pathways, that synthesizes photoacoustic data in both image and projection domains. Our method maps raw data into a downsampled latent space, preserving essential structural and semantic information while significantly reducing modeling dimensionality. The two pathways are trained separately to model their corresponding data distributions. To validate the framework, the generated data was used to train a reconstruction network for sparse-view, limited-view, and bandwidth-limited tasks. Experimental results show that models trained with synthetic data achieve performance comparable to reference data training in terms of structural fidelity, artifact suppression, and overall image quality. Quantitative evaluation via PSNR and SSIM metrics further confirms the high usability of the generated data. This study represents the first systematic exploration of dual-domain generation in PAT, offering a robust strategy for deep learning research under medical data constraints.

papers.abstract_en: Lung transplantation (LTx) remains the only definitive therapy for selected patients with end-stage lung disease, yet outcomes are limited by early ischemia-reperfusion injury (IRI) and primary graft dysfunction (PGD), and by chronic lung allograft dysfunction (CLAD) as the leading cause of late graft failure. These entities share overlapping injury and repair pathways, including alveolocapillary barrier disruption, microvascular dysfunction, innate immune activation, and maladaptive remodeling, which remain incompletely controlled by current perioperative management and systemic immunosuppression. This review summarizes cell and gene therapy approaches in LTx and frames these strategies around the IRI/PGD-to-CLAD continuum. Stromal cell therapies, regulatory immune cell approaches, and cell-free or cell-derived products such as extracellular vesicles and mitochondrial transfer are discussed, with emphasis on route, dose, persistence, and the graft microenvironment as determinants of biological activity. Gene modulation strategies and delivery platforms relevant to the lung, including viral vectors, lipid nanoparticles, and virus-like particles, are outlined, together with preclinical gene therapy strategies targeting IRI and allograft rejection. Ex vivo lung perfusion (EVLP) is highlighted as a practical window for organ-confined delivery and early mechanistic assessment prior to implantation. Key translational considerations are outlined, including product characterization and potency, clinically interpretable dosing, and the need for harmonized endpoints and pharmacodynamic readouts to improve comparability across studies.

papers.title_en: CCL11 as a cancer target: molecular role and the mechanisms for potential therapeutic intervention.
papers.authors: He Z, Wang M
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Laboratory Medicine, School of Clinical Medicine and Laboratory Medicine, Jiangsu University, Zhenjiang, J…
papers.authors_conclusion: 靶向CCL11需要分流：合理的干预模式取决于该轴已被验证的方向、占主导的受体-细胞配对以及信号应当被阻断还是增强。近期机会在于将已去风险的受体拮抗剂（尤其是maraviroc）再定位用于生物标志物指导的联合方案。尚无试验证实对CCL11的依赖，因此该轴最好通过其受体来推进。
papers.ai_note: 全文为专家观点与机制推演，无原始数据、无系统检索策略与定量合成，证据分级标准由作者自定义；“方向未定即可药物干预”“maraviroc再定位”属推断性建议而非试验支持的结论；文中明确指出无任何试验证实CCL11依赖，故所有受体层面的干预设想均为外推；未涉及具体瘤种、分期或胸科人群的效应量，对本刊读者仅为背景性信息。
papers.reason: 提供CCL11-CCR3/CCR5/CCR2轴在肿瘤微环境中的机制框架与证据分级思路，可用于评估嗜酸性粒细胞相关通路（含部分胸部肿瘤微环境研究）作为生物标志物或联合靶点的可行性边界，并提示当前缺乏依赖性证据、不宜据此设计干预性临床研究。
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: CCL11 (eotaxin-1) is dysregulated across human cancers and linked to proliferation, invasion, angiogenesis and metastatic niche formation. Its biology is more complex than that of a single oncogenic ligand, and whether and how to drug it remains unresolved. AREAS COVERED: We frame CCL11 as a multi-receptor, double-edged cancer target. Beyond CCR3, it acts as an agonist at CCR5 and an antagonist or weak partial agonist at CCR2, while ACKR1 and ACKR2 buffer the free ligand pool. The axis is pro-tumorigenic through tumor-cell, stromal and myeloid routes, yet tumor-suppressive when CCR3 on eosinophils drives antitumour activity; its net direction must therefore be established before a modality is selected. We grade each receptor-cell pairing by level of evidence, separating demonstrated effects from those extrapolated from receptor-sharing ligands, and assess four intervention layers against the redundancy, buffering and on-target liabilities that constrain translation. EXPERT OPINION: Targeting CCL11 requires triage: the rational modality depends on the validated direction of the axis, the dominant receptor-cell pairing, and whether signaling should be blocked or augmented. The near-term opportunity lies in repurposing de-risked receptor antagonists, particularly maraviroc, in biomarker-guided combinations. No trial has demonstrated CCL11 dependence, so the axis is best pursued through its receptors.

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: To examine the use of process mapping (PM) in clinical healthcare settings in low- and lower-middle-income countries (LLMICs). METHODS: A scoping review was conducted. Full-text empirical studies published from 2014 to 2024 were identified from MEDLINE, Embase, Web of Science, and CINAHL databases. RESULTS: Twenty-six articles were included. Deductive and inductive content analysis was performed. Applications have included process- and quality-improvement initiatives (n = 12), health system process analysis and assessment (n = 7), health systems tools design, implementation and evaluation (n = 4), and costing (n = 3). Observations, workshops and interviews were applied, with 65% using a single method (n = 17). PM was predominantly researcher-led (n = 17), with local healthcare workers participating in the majority of studies (n = 21); none involved patients. Gaps in reporting and documentation of PM activities were identified (n = 16). CONCLUSION: PM demonstrated significant potential as a versatile and adaptable method for improving clinical processes. Future PM studies should adhere to reporting guidelines, promote locally led PM activities and incorporate diverse perspectives, particularly those of patients.

pico.p: 2022年1月至2026年2月发表的护理教育相关文献；检索456条记录，最终纳入119篇研究
pico.ic: 暴露/关注点：文献中生成式AI的概念化方式（内容生成工具、学术诚信威胁、教学工具、职业形塑议题）；无对照干预

papers.reason: 与胸科临床判断无直接关联，但为AI进入临床决策（预警、风险算法）背景下的专业身份与AI素养议题提供文献学基线，可作为胸外科AI辅助诊疗落地时培训与能力框架讨论的间接参照
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The rapid integration of generative AI (GenAI) into nursing education has prompted widespread concern about academic integrity and assessment validity. However, this dominant discourse may obscure a more fundamental challenge: preparing nursing students for clinical practice environments where AI already mediates triage, diagnostics, documentation, and clinical decision-making. OBJECTIVE: This integrative review examines how GenAI is conceptualized within the nursing education literature and investigates the extent to which current discourse addresses professional formation rather than academic compliance. METHODS: Following Whittemore and Knafl's integrative review methodology, a systematic search of PubMed, Google Scholar, and SciSpace (Typeset) was conducted for literature published between January 2022 and February 2026. Two reviewers independently screened 456 records, with 119 papers meeting the inclusion criteria. The methodological quality of empirical studies was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool (MMAT). Corpus-level descriptive mapping quantified dominant themes and conceptual patterns, while an interpretive synthesis examined how GenAI was framed and the extent to which professional formation elements, including identity, moral agency, and clinical judgment, were addressed. RESULTS: Of the 119 unique studies analyzed, 84% (n=100) predominantly framed GenAI as a content-generation tool and academic integrity threat. Only 35.3% (n=42) conceptualized AI as a pedagogical tool, and a critical gap was identified in professional formation: identity formation was addressed in only 10% (n=12) of papers and moral agency in just 5% (n=6). Explicit acknowledgment that AI already routinely mediates frontline clinical decisions (eg, sepsis alerts and fall risk algorithms) in current practice settings was notably absent. The discourse emphasizes governance and faculty literacy, but sustained curricula addressing nurse identity in AI-mediated care remain underdeveloped. CONCLUSIONS: Current nursing education discourse predominantly frames AI as a writing tool and an academic integrity concern, failing to prepare students for the algorithmic practice environments they will inhabit. Nursing education must reframe AI as a professional formation issue, explicitly addressing how algorithms reshape clinical judgment, moral agency, and professional identity.

papers.results: 全队列平均急诊就诊率为0.73次/年，摘要称明显高于同年龄段一般人群；急诊使用较多者为年龄更小、适应功能更差、外化行为更多、亲社会行为更少及存在多系统复杂疾病的IDD儿童；高频就诊与医学共病高发相关，尤其癫痫与呼吸系统问题；地区差异显示伦敦与英格兰东北部使用相对较高；性别、族裔、社会经济剥夺、遗传变异类型及遗传状态未见影响就诊率

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Children and young people (CYP) with intellectual developmental disabilities (IDD) experience substantial health needs and higher healthcare utilisation compared with the general paediatric population. However, factors affecting the emergency healthcare use among children with IDD of genetic aetiology remain poorly understood. This study aimed to examine demographic, socioeconomic, behavioural, genetic, and clinical factors of emergency service use among CYP with IDD in England. METHODS: This retrospective cohort study used linked administrative healthcare data from Hospital Episode Statistics (HES) emergency service records obtained from National Health Service (NHS) England. Participants were CYP aged between 4 and 15.5 years with confirmed pathogenic genetic variants associated with IDD identified via NHS medical genetic clinics. The outcome was the yearly emergency service use rate, calculated as the total number of lifetime emergency visits divided by age (years). Independent variables included demographic and socioeconomic factors, genetic characteristics, region of residence, adaptive functioning, behavioural and emotional adjustment, prosocial behaviour, general health status, and system-specific medical conditions. Primary caregivers completed questionnaires and provided information regarding the child's medical history and demographic information. RESULTS: The average emergency attendance rate in this cohort was 0.73 visits per annum, which was much higher than that among children in the same age range from the general population. Emergency services were used more by younger IDD children with poorer adaptive functioning, more externalising and less prosocial behaviour, as well as those with complex multisystem conditions. Frequent attendance was associated with high rates of medical comorbidities especially seizures and respiratory problems. Regional differences were found with relatively higher usage in London and the North East of England. Attendance rates were not influenced by sex, ethnicity, socioeconomic deprivation, genetic variant type or inheritance status. CONCLUSIONS: This novel study demonstrated emergency healthcare utilisation among CYP with IDD of known genetic aetiology in England was primarily associated with clinical complexity, functional impairment, and younger age rather than socioeconomic or genetic factors. Their vulnerability to multisystem morbidity as well as regional disparities highlight the need for improved coordinated care and targeted service planning to reduce emergency healthcare dependence among children with disabilities.

papers.title_en: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted, Electrocardiogram-Derived, Sequential Rule-Based Decision Tree for Exclusion of Acute Coronary Syndrome as the Etiology of Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest: A Single-Center Retrospective Cohort Study.
papers.authors: Choi A, Yoon H, Won Lee SG, Park C, Han E, Roh YH, Kim JH
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Emergency Medicine, Yonsei University College of Medicine, Seoul, the Republic of Korea; Yonsei Institute …
papers.results: 决策树在开发队列将171/329（52.0%）、验证队列将32/71（45.1%）判为“ACS not likely”，任一节点均无经判定的ACS病例被误分类；收益集中于非可除颤亚组，该亚组排除169/261（64.8%）非ACS病例，AUROC 0.824，优于各单项标志物；在ACS验前概率高的可除颤亚组，38/40（95.0%）被保留为“ACS not excluded”。
papers.authors_conclusion: 按心律分层、基于规则的决策树联合AI辅助心电图衍生标志物，可将约半数OHCA后患者判为“ACS not likely”，且无经判定的ACS病例被误分类，主要见于非可除颤亚组；这一透明、床旁可部署的框架值得前瞻性多中心评价。
papers.ai_note: 零假阴性约束在开发队列内拟合，“无漏诊”属样本内性质而非泛化保证；验证队列仅71例、ACS事件数很少，45.1%排除率的精度与安全性无法可靠评估。主要收益集中于非可除颤亚组（ACS验前概率本就较低），对该亚组的临床排阴价值有限，且与可除颤亚组“95%保留”形成对比，提示模型实际未改变高疑诊人群的处理。全文未见任何置信区间、校准或决策曲线分析。所谓“AI辅助”仅用于生成10项标志物，最终模型为5变量的规则树，AI贡献与增量价值不清；5/10标志物的筛选过程未说明是否独立于结局。单中心回顾性设计，缺少外部验证。

pico.p: 成年院外心脏骤停（OHCA）自主循环恢复（ROSC）后患者；开发队列2020-2024年 n=329，时间验证队列2025年 n=71
pico.ic: 深度学习平台分析ROSC后12导联心电图生成10项数字标志物，选取5项构建按心律分层的序贯决策树（零假阴性约束），与单项标志物比较，并在时间验证队列中验证

papers.reason: 该研究针对ROSC后是否急诊冠脉造影这一决策难题，提供了一种床旁可解释的排阴规则；其价值主要在于为非可除颤亚组延迟或省略造影提供假设，但样本量与验证强度不足以支持改变现行流程，可作为后续前瞻性验证研究的对照基线。与胸外科/胸部肿瘤日常决策关联有限。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: After out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA) with return of spontaneous circulation (ROSC), deciding which patients without ST-segment elevation warrant emergency coronary angiography is difficult, as standard electrocardiogram (ECG), troponin, and echocardiography are limited in the early post-arrest window. We aimed to develop a sequential rule-based decision tree to identify post-ROSC patients in whom acute coronary syndrome (ACS) is unlikely to be the arrest etiology. METHODS: In this single-center retrospective study, adult patients with OHCA were divided into development (2020-2024; n=329) and temporal validation (2025; n=71) cohorts. Post-ROSC 12-lead ECGs were analyzed by a deep-learning platform generating ten digital biomarkers. Five candidate biomarkers were combined into a rhythm-stratified sequential decision tree under a zero false-negative constraint; its performance was compared with that of individual biomarkers and validated in the temporal cohort. RESULTS: The tree classified 171/329 (52.0%) and 32/71 (45.1%) patients in the development and validation cohorts, respectively, as "ACS not likely," with no adjudicated ACS case misclassified at any node. Yield concentrated in the non-shockable subgroup, in which the model excluded 169/261 (64.8%) non-ACS cases (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUROC], 0.824), outperforming each individual biomarker. In the shockable subgroup, which carries a high pretest probability of ACS, 38/40 patients (95.0%) were retained as "ACS not excluded." CONCLUSIONS: A rhythm-stratified, rule-based decision tree combining AI-assisted ECG-derived biomarkers classified approximately half of post-OHCA patients as "ACS not likely" with no adjudicated ACS case misclassified, principally in the non-shockable subgroup. This transparent, bedside-deployable framework warrants prospective multicenter evaluation.

papers.abstract_en: Nanovaccines have been engineered to co-deliver antigens and adjuvants for robust immune responses. While extensive studies have examined the effect of nanovaccine size, shape, surface charge, and targeting on vaccine efficacy, the impact of antigen density remains underexplored. Here, we systematically optimize the anti-tumor CD8+ T cell response by modulating the antigen density on an M13 phage-based nanovaccine. By fine-tuning the antigen ratio from ∼6.0% to ∼70.4% on the phage capsid, the anti-tumor CD8+ T cell response was enhanced. Further investigation demonstrated that the antigen density affected not only antigen presentation efficacy but also dendritic cell uptake. Applying this strategy to a neoantigen in the MC-38 colorectal cancer model, we achieved up to a ∼7-fold increase in the neoantigen-specific CD8+ T cell frequency, resulting in significant tumor suppression. These findings underscore the critical role of antigen density in nanovaccine design and establish M13 bacteriophage as a universal platform for personalized cancer vaccine applications.

papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pathology and Cell Biology, Columbia University Irving Medical Center, New York, New York, USA.
papers.results: 梯度扩散法必要一致率：bioMérieux 92.6%、Liofilchem 89.6%；四种产品分类一致率范围为81.5%–89.3%；所有分类差异均为次要错误，且几乎全部出现在折点附近菌株；培养基相关变异不大，质控表现总体较高，室内精密度强且两实验室间表现一致；IMPORTANCE中报告，重复及差异复核后任何产品均未残留重大错误或极重大错误
papers.authors_conclusion: 四种商品化AZA药敏产品与参考BMD相比均表现出可接受的分析性能；本研究为商品化AZA药敏产品的首个全面头对头比较，支持其在临床微生物实验室中推广应用
papers.ai_note: 分类一致率81.5%–89.3%整体低于药敏方法学惯用的≥90%可接受阈值，作者仍以“可接受的分析性能”定调，存在以必要一致率高值（梯度扩散92.6%/89.6%）淡化分类一致率不足的倾向；摘要仅报告复核/差异解决后“无重大或极重大错误”，未给出初测重大/极重大错误率的数值，无法判断错误纠正前的真实风险；菌株库刻意富集折点附近与非敏感菌株，会使CA估计偏保守，向常规菌群外推需谨慎；样本量56株、单一药物，且无临床结局关联数据。

pico.p: 56株碳青霉烯耐药肠杆菌目（CRE）临床分离株，富集非敏感及折点附近MIC菌株；在2个独立临床实验室、3个厂家的Mueller-Hinton琼脂上进行
pico.ic: 四种新上市的AZA药敏产品：梯度扩散法2种（bioMérieux Etest、Liofilchem MIC Test Strip）与纸片扩散法2种（Hardy、Liofilchem），以微量肉汤稀释法（BMD）为参考方法

papers.reason: 为临床微生物实验室引入氨曲南-阿维巴坦药敏检测提供首个多产品、跨实验室、跨培养基厂家的对照基线，可用于判断梯度扩散与纸片扩散法在折点附近菌株上的错误风险；与胸科业务的直接关联仅限CRE感染患者的抗感染方案落地，故专科相关性评分低。
papers.abstract_en: Aztreonam-avibactam (AZA) is a recently approved agent active against metallo-β-lactamase-producing Enterobacterales. However, independent evaluations of commercially available antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST) products remain limited. We evaluated 56 carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales isolates using four newly available AZA AST products, including two gradient diffusion tests (bioMérieux Etest; Liofilchem MIC Test Strip) and two disk diffusion tests (Hardy, Liofilchem) across three Mueller-Hinton agar manufacturers at two independent clinical laboratories. A diverse isolate collection enriched for nonsusceptible and breakpoint-adjacent MICs was used to rigorously assess categorical agreement (CA). Broth microdilution (BMD) was used as the reference method. Essential agreement (EA), categorical agreement, error rates, and reproducibility were analyzed. All four commercial AST products demonstrated acceptable analytical performance compared with reference BMD. Gradient diffusion demonstrated high EA (bioMérieux 92.6%, Liofilchem 89.6%), whereas CA ranged from 81.5% to 89.3% across all four products. Minor errors accounted for all categorical discrepancies and occurred almost exclusively among breakpoint-adjacent isolates. Medium-related variability was modest, and quality control (QC) performance was generally high, with strong within-site precision and consistent performance across laboratories. This study provides the first comprehensive head-to-head comparison of commercial AZA susceptibility testing products and supports their implementation in clinical microbiology laboratories.IMPORTANCEAztreonam-avibactam is an important new treatment option for infections caused by carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales, particularly metallo-β-lactamase-producing organisms, but its clinical use requires reliable susceptibility testing. We provide the first head-to-head evaluation of four newly available commercial gradient and disk diffusion products across two independent laboratories and three Mueller-Hinton agar manufacturers. By using a diverse isolate collection enriched for MICs near clinical breakpoints, we also subjected these products to a stringent assessment of categorical agreement. Gradient diffusion demonstrated high essential agreement, and no major or very major errors remained after repeat and discrepancy testing with any product. These findings provide timely, practical evidence to guide clinical laboratories implementing aztreonam-avibactam susceptibility testing.

papers.abstract_en: The systemic treatment landscape of unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma has been transformed by immune-checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)-based regimens. These advances have led to efforts to combine ICIs with locoregional therapies (LRTs), particularly transarterial chemoembolization, transarterial radioembolization and external beam radiotherapy, in an attempt to improve tumour control and extend the benefits of ICIs to patients with intermediate-stage disease. The rationale for this combination approach is provided by the ability of LRTs to induce immunogenic cell death and tumour antigen release and to reprogramme the immunosuppressive tumour microenvironment. Five phase III trials have thus far shown improvements in progression-free survival and objective response rates with regimens combining ICIs with transarterial chemoembolization. Early-phase and real-world data also support the combination of ICIs with transarterial radioembolization or external beam radiotherapy, particularly in selected patients with focal disease unsuitable for embolization or portal vein tumour thrombosis. However, various challenges remain, including patient selection and therapy sequencing, response assessment, and the growing difficulties in demonstrating survival advantages in the context of widespread post-progression crossover and effective subsequent therapies. In this Review, we describe the biological rationale, summarize the clinical evidence and discuss future directions for trial design, imaging and biomarker-driven patient selection in the integration of LRTs with immune-based regimens for patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma.

papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Critical Care Medicine, The First Affiliated Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine, Hangzhou, 3…
papers.authors_conclusion: 提出以病程轨迹为导向的概念框架，将管理措施与最可能限制康复的环节相链接，并区分临床可实施干预与新兴转化概念；强调经验性治疗需结合本地流行病学，且在疗效延迟、恶化或恢复不全时应重新评估限制因素（持续感染、药物暴露不足、宿主反应失调、非感染性模仿、修复受限）。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：未提供检索策略、文献纳入标准、证据分级或任何定量数据，属观点性综述；核心框架未经验证，文中“日益精准”等表述缺乏可核查的支撑数据；将多种失败轨迹归类的分类法本身尚无一致性或预后效度证据。
papers.reason: 与胸外科/胸部肿瘤的主体业务关联弱，仅对围手术期肺部感染、术后肺炎的抗菌策略选择与“治疗反应不佳”原因判读提供概念性参考，不改变肿瘤诊疗判断。
papers.abstract_en: Management of drug-resistant bacterial pneumonia has become increasingly precise, but early precision does not remove the need to reinterpret the patient's course during illness. Active and appropriate empirical therapy, informed by local epidemiology, remains essential, yet treatment often begins before the definitive microbiological profile is available or adequate drug exposure can be confirmed. While rapid diagnostics and pharmacological optimisation can narrow this initial uncertainty, the harder problem arises when antimicrobial treatment appears plausible but the patient shows delayed improvement, clinical deterioration, or incomplete recovery. These trajectories should not be treated as a single form of antibiotic failure. Instead, they require reassessment of whether the dominant limitation is persistent infection, inadequate drug exposure, dysregulated host response, a non-infectious mimic, or repair-limited recovery. In this Review, we propose a trajectory-guided conceptual framework that links management to the process most likely to limit recovery and distinguishes clinically implementable interventions from emerging translational concepts.

papers.title_en: Validating complete-airway computational fluid dynamics (CA-CFD) predictions of regional aerosol deposition in human subjects: comparisons with in vivo data of pharmaceutical aerosol delivery during HFNC therapy.
papers.authors: Kolanjiyil AV, Dutta R, Maradiaga A, Grey C, Aladwani G, Dalton C, Momin MAM, Hindle M et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Mechanical and Nuclear Engineering, Virginia Commonwealth University, Richmond, VA, United States of Ameri…
papers.results: CA-CFD预测的肺部沉积分数为雾化剂量的2.9%，在体数据中位数为2.1%（γ闪烁显像；范围1.5-2.9%）和3.7%（SPECT-CT；范围2.2-4.7%）；采用真实多分散液滴粒径分布的随机单路径（SIP）模型给出的区域沉积分数为：鼻咽喉16%、上段气管支气管0.5%、中段气管支气管0.1%、下段气管支气管0.1%、肺泡区2.4%（均为雾化剂量百分比），约22%雾化剂量被呼出/逸出/滴漏，约58%损失于HFNC回路中
papers.authors_conclusion: 通过系统化开发建立的HFNC治疗期间气溶胶递送的CA-CFD模型与在体队列水平数据高度一致，现可作为“代表性人群水平数字孪生”用于优化这一极具挑战但临床常用的通气支持模式下的气溶胶递送
papers.ai_note: 验证仅对照既往发表数据的队列水平中位数/范围，未做个体水平配对比较，摘要亦未报告任何一致性统计量（如一致性相关系数、Bland-Altman限）；预测值2.9%落在SPECT-CT范围（2.2-4.7%）之下缘附近、略高于γ闪烁显像中位数，两种在体方法本身相差近1.8倍，所谓“高度一致”缺乏定量判据；模型是否曾用同一批数据进行调参（校准与验证未分离）在摘要中信息不足；“数字孪生”属外推性表述，摘要未提供前瞻性验证。

papers.abstract_en: High-Flow Nasal Cannula (HFNC) is a critical tool for respiratory support in acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) and for subjects with general hypoxemia; however, pharmaceutical aerosol delivery simultaneous with HFNC support is known to be highly inefficient. The aim of this study was to develop and validate a high-fidelity, complete-airway computational fluid dynamics (CA-CFD) model of regional aerosol deposition that occurs when a pharmaceutical aerosol product is administered through a nasal interface simultaneously with HFNC therapy. The CFD model included the aerosol delivery tubing and interface connected to a complete-airway (CA) model extending from the extrathoracic nose-throat (NT) region through the conducting airways and alveoli. CFD-predicted regional aerosol deposition was compared with previously published in vivo experimental data. Predictions of the CA-CFD model agreed closely with the available cohort-level human-subject in vivo data including a predicted aerosol deposition fraction in the lungs of 2.9% (based on nebulized dose) compared with in vivo medians of 2.1% (gamma scintigraphy; range: 1.5-2.9%) and 3.7% (SPECT-CT; range: 2.2-4.7%). In addition to low lung delivery efficiency, the regional drug delivery showed high heterogeneity. Considering a map of regional airway deposition, utilizing a realistic polydisperse droplet size distribution in the stochastic individual path (SIP) models, deposition fractions in the NT, upper tracheobronchial (TB), middle TB, lower TB and alveolar regions were 16%, 0.5%, 0.1%, 0.1%, and 2.4% of the nebulized dose, with ∼ 22% of the nebulized dose exhaled/escaped/dripped, while ∼ 58% was lost in the HFNC circuit. Through methodical development, a CA-CFD model of aerosol delivery during HFNC therapy was established that closely agrees with the in vivo cohort-level data and can now serve as a "representative population-level digital twin" to optimize aerosol delivery during this highly challenging but clinically popular mode of ventilation support.

papers.authors: Golob MM, Livingstone-Banks J, Vandvik PO, Michaels M, Hodder R, Munn Z, Thomas J, Riaz IB et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Oxford Lifelong Learning, University of Oxford, Oxford, UK; Washington State Health Care Authority, Olympia, Washington,…
papers.results: 29名专家组成德尔菲专家组，第1轮27人（93%）完成、第2轮26人（90%）、第3轮27人（93%）；22条最终声明中19条达成共识：12条关于实施（conduct），2条关于报告，4条关于发表，1条关于实施/评价（implementation/appraisal）；共对23条声明进行评分
papers.authors_conclusion: 本研究提出了首个基于专家共识的医疗领域LES考虑、开展、发表与实施的最佳实践声明；这些声明有助于统一全球流程、提高透明度并促进可持续性。但实现上述目标仍有更多工作要做，需要各团体合作采纳数字工具、采用互操作性标准并建立有效的评价工具。
papers.ai_note: 摘要称对23条声明评分，但最终声明为22条，未说明删减/合并过程及原因；共识定义为≥80%同意，却未报告任何单条声明的同意比例、离散度或未达成共识的3条具体内容；未说明专家组的学科、地域、收入国家分布及利益冲突管理，也无患者/公众或方法学外利益方代表信息；“首个”为作者自我定位，未做系统检索佐证；未报告定性反馈如何改变声明措辞（是否存在引导性修订）；德尔菲本身为专家意见层面证据，不能替代对LES实际效率/质量的效应评价。信息不足：单条声明共识度、未达成共识条目、面板构成细节。

pico.p: 全球范围内具有LES生产/支持专长的专家，德尔菲专家组29人（第1轮完成27人/93%，第2轮26人/90%，第3轮27人/93%）
pico.ic: 干预：基于既往调查、工作坊及正在进行的LES批判性解释性合成的草案声明，经3轮JISC在线调查，对23条声明按5点Likert评分并依据定性反馈迭代修订；对照：无平行对照，共识阈值预设为≥80%同意且每轮应答率≥85%

papers.reason: 为动态证据合成（含胸科肿瘤领域快速更新的系统综述/指南联动）提供流程与报告规范参考，可作为开展living review/living guideline的方法学对照基线，但对具体手术、结节或药物决策无直接影响。
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: Living evidence syntheses (LES) represent continual updates for an important topic for decision-making where there is uncertainty in the evidence. Whereas best practices for traditional evidence syntheses in health care are well established, they are not for LES. This study aimed to establish globally relevant consensus statements for considering, conducting, publishing, and implementing LES in health care. STUDY DESIGN AND SETTING: A modified Delphi consensus process was conducted. Potential participants were identified through a prior survey, workshop, and targeted outreach based on expertise and representation across global organizations producing or supporting LES. Three modified Delphi rounds were administered using JISC Online Surveys between January and April 2025. Participants rated 23 statements on a five-point Likert scale. Consensus was defined as ≥80% agreement ('Agree' or 'Strongly Agree') with ≥85% panel response rate required per round. Qualitative feedback guided iterative statement revision. Draft statements were informed by an overview of living systematic reviews, a living evidence survey plus workshop activity, and an ongoing living critical interpretive synthesis of LES. Statements expanded upon the living methodology reporting guidance published by the PRISMA-LSR group to include other considerations for LES. RESULTS: The Delphi panel comprised 29 experts from around the world, with 27 (93%) completing round 1, 26 (90%) round 2, and 27 (93%) completing round 3. Nineteen of 22 final statements achieved consensus: 12 on conduct (including set up and maintenance of living mode as well as funding and resources), 2 on reporting, 4 on publishing, and 1 on implementation/appraisal. Final statements included ways to enable the living mode, such as version history; authoring tools; collaboration; unit of update; transparency; communication; publication considerations; and digital and technological considerations. CONCLUSION: This study presents the first expert consensus-based best-practice statements for considering, conducting, publishing, and implementing LES in health care. These statements can help align global processes, improve transparency, and promote sustainability. But there is still more to be done to accomplish these objectives, requiring that groups collaborate to embrace digital tools, adopt interoperability standards, and create effective appraisal tools.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Serous ovarian carcinoma (SOC) is a highly aggressive gynaecological malignancy with frequent relapse and the development of chemoresistance. A major feature of SOC tumour microenvironment is the accumulation of dense collagen fibres, which promote tumour progression and immune evasion. Discoidin domain receptor 2 (DDR2), a collagen-binding receptor tyrosine kinase activated by fibrillar collagens, mediates extracellular matrix-associated signalling involved in tumour progression and immune exclusion. However, its role in limiting antitumour immunity and contributing to immunotherapy resistance in SOC remains poorly understood. METHODS: We investigated the impact of DDR2 blockade on SOC-specific T cell activity and on the efficacy of recombinant bispecific antibodies (BsAbs) targeting CD28 and mucin 1 (MUC1). SOC-specific T cells were generated from healthy donor peripheral blood mononuclear cells and assessed for recruitment, activation, and cytotoxicity against low-grade (OVCA433) and high-grade (OVCAR3) SOC cell lines under different treatment conditions. RESULTS: DDR2 inhibition enhanced SOC-specific T cell responses by remodelling the collagen matrix, favouring their recruitment, activation and cytotoxic activity against both low- and high-grade SOC cells. Moreover, combined treatment with DDR2 blockade and CD28xMUC1 BsAbs significantly increased the recruitment of SOC-specific T cells, granzyme B release, caspase-3 activation, and cytokine production. CONCLUSIONS: DDR2 blockade mitigates collagen-mediated immune exclusion and enhances the efficacy of CD28xMUC1 BsAb-based immunotherapy in SOC models. These findings provide a mechanistic rationale for further investigation of combined DDR2 targeting and CD28×MUC1 costimulatory strategies to improve ovarian cancer immunotherapy.

papers.authors: Alnomasy N, Alrashedi H, Pangket P

papers.results: 条目水平内容效度指数0.83–1.00，量表水平内容效度指数平均0.94；删除4个条目后，验证性因子分析（CFA）对52条目5因子模型提供初步支持：CFI=0.930，TLI=0.926，RMSEA=0.055，SRMR=0.103，GFI=0.947；内部一致性信度估计0.856–0.919；部分已知组比较亦提供初步效度证据（未报告具体数值）

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The rapid progress in digital transformation and the increasing reliance on AI in health care have created an urgent need for validated assessments of digital and AI literacy among nursing students. However, there is a substantial gap in culturally adapted assessment tools for Arabic-speaking populations. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to translate, culturally adapt, and conduct a preliminary psychometric evaluation of the Arabic version of the Nursing Digital and AI Literacy Assessment (NURS-DIAL). METHODS: This cross-sectional study evaluated the Arabic-translated and culturally adapted version of the NURS-DIAL. The psychometric evaluation included content validity, confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) using diagonally weighted least squares estimation, internal consistency reliability, construct validity, and known-groups validity. Given the complexity of the 52-item, 5-factor NURS-DIAL model and the limited sample size, the CFA findings should be interpreted as preliminary. RESULTS: Content validity was strong, with item-level content validity indices ranging from 0.83 to 1.00 and a scale-level content validity index average of 0.94. CFA provided preliminary support for a 52-item, 5-factor model after removing 4 items. Model fit indices were as follows: comparative fit index was 0.930, Tucker-Lewis index was 0.926, root mean square error of approximation was 0.055, standardized root mean square residual was 0.103, and goodness-of-fit index was 0.947. The internal consistency estimates ranged from 0.856 to 0.919. Selected known-group comparisons also provided preliminary validity evidence. CONCLUSIONS: The NURS-DIAL demonstrated preliminary evidence of content validity, structural validity, internal consistency reliability, and construct validity among nursing students at 1 university in Saudi Arabia. Because of the limited sample size and single-institution setting, the tool should currently be used for exploratory research and formative assessment in similar settings. Larger multi-institutional studies are needed to confirm its factor structure and broader applicability.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Acute lung injury (ALI) is a life-threatening inflammatory pulmonary disorder characterized by excessive inflammation, oxidative stress, and disruption of lung tissue integrity. Macrophage dysregulation plays a critical role in the progression of ALI, making macrophage modulation a potential therapeutic strategy. Tectorigenin (Tec), a natural isoflavonoid with anti-inflammatory activity, has shown protective effects in inflammatory disorders, but its underlying mechanism and macrophage-targeted delivery in ALI remain unclear. Here, we developed a macrophage membrane-camouflaged MOF818 nanozyme for macrophage-targeted delivery of Tec, termed T-M@MM, to enhance its therapeutic efficacy against ALI. METHODS: The effects of Tec and T-M@MM were evaluated in LPS-induced ALI mice and LPS- or TBHP-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages. Macrophage depletion, network pharmacology, molecular docking, and cellular thermal shift assay were used to investigate the underlying mechanisms. Macrophage polarization, glycolysis, oxidative stress, mitochondrial function, and apoptosis were assessed using molecular and cellular assays. The physicochemical properties, Tec loading and release profiles, macrophage uptake, pulmonary biodistribution, biosafety, and therapeutic efficacy of T-M@MM were further evaluated. RESULTS: Tec alleviated pulmonary inflammation and oxidative stress and promoted an anti-inflammatory macrophage phenotype, whereas macrophage depletion attenuated these effects. PFKFB3 was identified as a potential molecular target associated with the effects of Tec, and Tec suppressed PFKFB3-associated glycolysis and promoted anti-inflammatory macrophage polarization, which was attenuated by PFKFB3 overexpression. T-M@MM enabled Tec loading and exhibited pH/ROS-responsive release, enhanced macrophage uptake and pulmonary retention (>48 h), and potent ROS-scavenging activity. In LPS-induced ALI mice, T-M@MM alleviated pulmonary inflammation, oxidative stress, edema, and pathological injury without obvious abnormalities in major-organ histology, liver or kidney function, or body weight. CONCLUSION: T-M@MM integrates macrophage targeting, ROS scavenging, and Tec-mediated modulation of PFKFB3-associated glycolysis to regulate macrophage responses and ameliorate LPS-induced ALI, with preliminary evidence of favorable biocompatibility, providing a potential macrophage-targeted nanotherapeutic strategy.

papers.abstract_en: UNLABELLED: Weak binding avidity restricts the application of natural T-cell receptors (TCRs) as therapeutic agents. Currently, display technologies have been extensively utilized for avidity optimization of TCRs, yet they tend to be resource-intensive and random. Deep learning models have emerged as promising tools capable of surmounting the constraints of experimental screening. However, the lack of training data has hampered their application in avidity optimization of TCRs. In this study, we profiled peptide-human leukocyte antigen (pHLA) binding fitness landscapes, surveying each amino acid in complementarity-determining region 3 of an influenza matrix peptide (58-66)-HLA-A*02:01 targeting TCR, and performed deep sequencing on the site-directed mutant libraries displayed in human embryonic kidney 293 T cells after pHLA screening, to generate unique training data for deep learning models. The fully trained model was subsequently employed to screen a computationally generated multi-site variant library and predict the antigen-specific optimized TCR candidates. Finally, twenty variants with antigen specificity and three variants with enhanced avidity were identified. The binding affinity calculated by free energy perturbation demonstrated consistent results. The integration of deep learning models and mammalian cell display allows for investigation of any residue within the TCR-antigen interface and a larger accessible sequences of TCRs, leading to an efficient avidity optimization of TCRs. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s43657-025-00295-w.

papers.abstract_en: Despite long-standing evidence of poor health and life expectancy outcomes among men, particularly among men who are socially or structurally marginalised, men's health has generally received little and uneven attention in health policy and practice. Its gendered and intersectional aspects have been especially overlooked. This third paper in the Lancet Men's Health Series examines why men's health has received so little policy attention and proposes strategies to raise men's health on national and global agendas. We applied a gender lens to the 3-i theory-based framework and analysed how ideas, interests, and institutions shape the prioritisation of men's health within national and global policy agendas. We review the modest development of men's health policies and assess how power and politics, including the roles of a range of stakeholders from global and national health spaces, commercial actors, and civil society organisations, have shaped the construction of the problem as well as policy attention and framing, resource allocation, and interventions. The scarcity of attention paid to men's health on global and national agendas reflects how power operates through ideas and institutions which contribute to the conflation of gender with women, institutional inertia, and contested constructions of individual versus structural drivers of ill health. We highlight how this has created a space in which commercial actors, including the manosphere, can shape narratives and influence men's health in ways that align with commercial or ideological interests. We conclude by proposing politically informed strategies that recognise how power, institutional arrangements, and competing interests shape men's health policy within prevailing gender and structural orders. We identify entry points for advancing men's health equity and wellbeing that draw on empirical evidence and technical guidance, are grounded in political realities, and are consistent with a commitment to gender justice for all people.

papers.abstract_en: AI models have enabled substantial advances in health care. Since the entry into force of the European Union (EU) AI Act in 2024, these systems have become subject to a common regulatory framework in the EU intended to harmonize AI governance across all member states. One of the act's distinctive features is that it accommodates existing economic, technological, and regulatory differences among European countries by leaving certain implementation responsibilities to national authorities. This is evident in regulatory sandboxes, supervised environments for developing, testing, and validating AI systems before deployment. In this viewpoint, we provide a policy-oriented analysis of health care regulatory sandboxes under the EU AI Act and propose recommendations for their design. These recommendations address the need to document model compression techniques that may affect the classification of large high-risk systems above the 1025 floating point operations per second threshold, incorporate explainability into AI systems from the design stage, identify and document biases in health care datasets, clarify the treatment of federated learning parameter updates under the General Data Protection Regulation, and strengthen the oversight of AI agents in clinical environments. The implementation timeline makes this discussion particularly timely given the approaching deadline of August 2, 2027, by which all member states must have established at least one national regulatory sandbox.

papers.abstract_en: Distal lung delivery remains a key bottleneck for inhaled therapy in severe pulmonary disease. We developed a hydrogen-oxygen mixture (H2/O2 mixture, 2:1 v/v) gas-assisted nebulization platform to deliver ROS-responsive, self-assembled methylprednisolone dimer nanoparticles (MP2-TK NPs). MP2-TK NPs were stable during nebulization and selectively released drug under ROS-rich conditions. Compared with air, H2/O2 mixture improved NGI-assessed aerosol deposition and artificial mucus penetration. CFD simulations further supported enhanced distal deposition, particularly for clinically respirable droplets (1-5 μm). In an LPS-induced acute lung injury mouse model, H2/O2-assisted nebulization increased pulmonary distribution and small-airway localization of MP2-TK NPs, leading to reduced bronchoalveolar lavage cytokines (IL-6, TNF-α, IL-1β), total cell counts, and protein levels. H2/O2 mixture inhalation alone also showed anti-inflammatory activity, consistent with hydrogen's antioxidant effects. This strategy couples carrier-gas engineering with ROS-responsive nanomedicine to enhance deep-lung delivery and therapeutic efficacy in acute lung injury.

papers.abstract_en: Ketamine drug products for parenteral use are commonly packaged in multi-use clear glass vials. However, light exposure may cause formation of N-nitroso-ketamine (NNKet), a potential carcinogen and nitrosamine drug substance-related impurity (NDSRI) of regulatory concern. To better understand ketamine photostability and nitrosamine formation potential, a photostability investigation was performed using a two-stage approach evaluating ambient and intense light exposure followed by post-exposure storage. This design reflects clinical reality where multi-use injectable ketamine experiences multiple intermittent light exposures during use. A selective and sensitive UHPLC-MS/MS analytical procedure was developed and validated for NNKet quantification. Sample preparation required solid phase extraction (SPE) to separate NNKet from ketamine before LC-MS/MS measurement, essential for overcoming autosampler contamination and ionization suppression from million-fold excess ketamine. Unexpectedly, NNKet concentration initially decreased during light exposure but rapidly increased during post-exposure storage. NNKet increased from baseline levels of approximately 5 ng/mL and exceeded the lowest acceptable intake limit of 14 ng/mL for 10 mg/mL ketamine drug product, reaching 100 ng/mL in some cases within 8 weeks of post-exposure storage. Control samples (light-protected vials) showed minimal NNKet change (maximum increase of 4.7 ng/mL from baseline). Kinetic modeling and experiments were attempted to explain the underlying mechanism. These findings demonstrate a post-market safety concern for ketamine drug products stored in clear glass vials, suggesting that container-closure systems minimizing light exposure, such as amber glass vials, may help mitigate nitrosamine formation risks in ketamine drug products.

papers.affiliation_highlight: School of Public Health, Shandong Medical and Pharmaceutical University, Yantai, Shandong 264003, P.R.
papers.authors_conclusion: 强调以代谢为基础的干预具有前景，并讨论了将这些发现转化为有效治疗的挑战。
papers.ai_note: 叙述性综述，未报告系统检索策略、纳入排除标准或证据分级；治疗部分主要基于临床前小分子抑制剂与非编码RNA证据，向临床转化需谨慎；摘要无定量结果，方法学信息不足。
papers.reason: 为非肿瘤性肺纤维化的糖酵解机制与候选靶点提供综述框架，可供胸部疾病转化研究选题参考，但不直接改变胸外科肿瘤临床决策。
papers.abstract_en: Pulmonary fibrosis (PF) is a chronic and progressive interstitial lung disease with a poor prognosis and limited therapeutic options. Current antifibrotic therapies only slow disease progression, underscoring an urgent need for novel therapeutic strategies. In recent years, metabolic reprogramming, notably the shift towards aerobic glycolysis (the Warburg effect), has emerged as a key driver of PF pathogenesis. This review comprehensively examines the central role of glycolysis in fueling the fibrotic cascade. It summarizes the major risk factors and fundamental pathogenic mechanisms of PF. The review then delves into the molecular mechanisms by which profibrotic signals, such as TGF‑β1, remodel cellular metabolism. The upregulation and pathogenic roles of critical glycolytic nodes are detailed‑including glucose transporters, hexokinase 2, phosphofructokinase‑2/fructose‑2,6‑bisphosphatase 3, pyruvate kinase M2 and lactate dehydrogenase A‑in activated fibroblasts, injured epithelial cells and pro‑fibrotic immune cells. Furthermore, the interplay between glycolysis and key signaling pathways (TGF‑β1, hypoxia‑inducible factor‑1α, PI3K/AKT/mTOR, Hippo, AMP‑activated protein kinase and sirtuins) that form feed‑forward loops to sustain the fibrotic process is discussed. Furthermore, therapeutic strategies targeting glycolytic enzymes and upstream metabolic checkpoints are highlighted, summarizing preclinical evidence for small‑molecule inhibitors and non‑coding RNAs as emerging regulators of glycolytic reprogramming. By consolidating current knowledge on glycolysis‑centric metabolic underpinnings of PF, this review underscores the promise of metabolism‑based interventions and discusses challenges for translating these findings into effective therapies.

papers.title_zh: miLab MAL AI驱动自动数字显微系统与标准镜检检测疟原虫的诊断性能比较：单中心前瞻性162例，检出敏感性高但虫种鉴别与虫负荷定量存在缺陷
papers.title_en: Diagnostic performance of the miLab MAL AI-driven automated digital microscopy system versus standard microscopy for Plasmodium spp. detection.
papers.authors: Monpierre L, Elaiba Y, Louboutin N, Ruiz P, Foulet F, Houzé S, Durand R, Botterel F et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Unité de Parasitologie, Hôpitaux Universitaires Henri Mondor, Créteil, France.
papers.results: 常规方法检出83例阳性、79例阴性；miLab MAL检出76例阳性、86例阴性。与LAMP和/或厚血膜比较：敏感性90.4%、特异性98.7%、Cohen's kappa 0.89；与单纯薄血膜镜检比较：敏感性97.4%、特异性97.7%、kappa 0.95。虫种鉴定方面：11例P. falciparum未在种水平正确鉴定，2例P. ovale与1例P. malariae被误鉴定为P. vivax；miLab MAL总体上倾向于低估原虫血症水平。
papers.authors_conclusion: miLab MAL在法国的首次评估显示其对疟原虫检测具有良好性能，但在虫种鉴别和原虫血症定量方面仍需改进；进一步优化后，该方法可能成为资源有限或高负担地区疟疾诊断的有价值工具。
papers.ai_note: 摘要以“高敏感性/高特异性”为主口径，但与薄血膜镜检比较所得的97.4%敏感性属对敏感性较低参照的二次比较，会系统性抬高性能估计，主要参照（LAMP和/或厚血膜）下敏感性为90.4%；11例恶性疟未正确鉴定到种、虫负荷被低估，恰是决定临床用药与随访的关键维度，摘要将其置于末位；未提及阅片者盲法、参照标准判读与AI输出的独立性，亦未报告不确定/不可判读样本的处理；单中心、样本量有限且含治疗后随访样本，谱偏倚可能影响敏感性外推。

pico.p: 疑似疟疾或治疗后随访患者的血液样本162份（法国，6个月前瞻性收集）
pico.ic: miLab MAL（AI辅助薄血膜自动显微系统）检测疟原虫，对照为常规诊断方法；参照标准为LAMP和/或厚血膜，另与单纯薄血膜镜检比较

papers.reason: 提供AI辅助数字显微在病原体检测中的准确性验证实例，可作为胸科AI病理/影像类诊断工具研究在参照标准选择、二次比较抬高效应量、虫（病）种级鉴别与定量能力等设计问题上的方法学对照；与胸部肿瘤临床决策无直接关联。
papers.abstract_en: Microscopic detection of Plasmodium spp. using thin and thick blood smears remains the gold standard for diagnosing malaria, but its performance is highly dependent on stain quality and microscopist expertise. Recently, artificial intelligence (AI)-based technologies have enhanced laboratory performance in malaria diagnosis. This study aimed to evaluate the performance of miLab MAL (Noul, Inc., Republic of Korea), an AI-assisted microscopy system designed to detect Plasmodium species using thin blood smears. Over a 6-month period, 162 blood samples from patients with suspected malaria or undergoing post-treatment follow-up were prospectively analyzed using conventional diagnostic methods and compared with miLab MAL results. Conventional methods identified 83 positive and 79 negative samples, whereas miLab MAL identified 76 positive and 86 negative samples. Compared with loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) and/or thick blood smear, miLab MAL showed a sensitivity of 90.4%, a specificity of 98.7%, and a Cohen's kappa of 0.89. When compared with thin smear microscopy alone, sensitivity increased to 97.4%, with a specificity of 97.7% and a kappa value of 0.95. Regarding species identification, 11 P. falciparum were not correctly identified at the species level, while two P. ovale and one P. malariae were misidentified as P. vivax by the miLab MAL. Overall, the miLab MAL tended to underestimate parasitemia. This first evaluation of miLab MAL in France shows a promising performance for Plasmodium detection, although improvements are needed for species differentiation and parasitemia quantification. With further optimization, this approach may become a valuable tool for malaria diagnosis in resource-limited or high-burden settings.IMPORTANCEArtificial intelligence (AI)-assisted microscopy is a promising approach to improving the consistency and accuracy of malaria diagnosis, particularly in laboratories with limited microscopy expertise. In this study, we evaluated the performance of the miLab MAL, an AI-assisted digital microscopy system developed for the rapid detection and identification of Plasmodium species in clinical samples. The system demonstrated high sensitivity and specificity for Plasmodium detection, suggesting its potential value as a diagnostic support tool in routine laboratory settings. However, limitations were identified in species-level identification and parasite quantification.

papers.title_zh: 细颗粒物经线粒体分裂和不完全自噬诱导肺上皮EMT，吡非尼酮在细胞和小鼠中减轻该过程
papers.title_en: Pirfenidone reduces fine particulate matter-induced epithelial to mesenchymal transition in lung epithelial cells through regulating mitochondrial fission and autophagy.
papers.authors: Chen YC, Chen YC, Chang W, Lee IT, Then WZ, Chiu YC, Lee CW, Chuang TY et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Anatomy and Cell Biology, College of Medicine, National Taiwan University, No.
papers.results: PM暴露降低上皮标志物E-cadherin表达，升高间质标志物vimentin、α-SMA和TGF-β1表达；上调EMT相关转录因子Snail和Slug；A549细胞由立方状转为纺锤状并增强迁移；PM促进线粒体分裂并诱导LC3B和p62蛋白积累；PFD治疗减少PM诱导的EMT相关蛋白表达和细胞迁移，并减少线粒体分裂、增加自噬体积累及相关自噬降解；PM处理小鼠肺组织EMT相关蛋白表达增加、血细胞浸润和肺泡壁增厚，PFD治疗改善这些表现并减少胶原沉积。
papers.authors_conclusion: PM通过增加线粒体分裂和不完全自噬（自噬体聚集伴通量受损）导致EMT；PFD可通过调控这些通路有效减少PM诱导的EMT形成。
papers.ai_note: 摘要未报告样本量、重复次数、统计方法与P值/CI；'自噬通量受损'仅由LC3B/p62聚集推断，未见通量阻断实验数据；体外使用A549癌细胞系而非原代II型肺泡上皮细胞，向人体肺上皮和临床转化需谨慎；PFD效果为模型内机制性结果，不能外推为临床防治空气污染相关肺病。

pico.p: 人II型肺泡上皮细胞A549；小鼠（气管内注射PM模拟空气污染暴露）；样本量摘要未报告
pico.ic: PM暴露（体外100 µg/mL；小鼠气管内注射）；对照设置摘要未明；干预为吡非尼酮（PFD）治疗

papers.reason: 为空气污染相关肺泡上皮EMT及线粒体分裂-自噬机制提供临床前证据，可作为抗纤维化药物老药新用的机制对照；对胸外科肿瘤诊疗决策的直接影响有限。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Epidemiological studies have shown that fine particulate matter (PM) is closely associated with increased morbidity and mortality from lung diseases. However, the mechanisms by which PM affects alveolar epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), such as mitochondrial dysfunction, remain unclear, and therapy options require further investigation. METHODS: Human type II alveolar epithelial cells (A549 cells) were exposed to 100 µg/mL PM to investigate EMT induction. In an animal model, mice were exposed to PM via intratracheal injection to simulate air pollution exposure. RESULTS: PM exposure reduced the expression of the epithelial marker E-cadherin while increasing the expression of mesenchymal markers vimentin, α-smooth muscle actin (α-SMA), and transforming growth factor β1 (TGF-β1). Furthermore, the expression of EMT-related transcription factors Snail and Slug was upregulated, accompanied by a morphological shift in A549 cells from cubic to spindle shapes and enhanced cell migration. PM also promoted mitochondrial fission and induced the accumulation of LC3B and p62 proteins. Treatment with the antifibrotic drug pirfenidone (PFD) effectively reduced PM-induced EMT-related protein expression and cell migration. These effects are achieved by reducing mitochondrial fission, increasing autophagosome accumulation, and related autophagic degradation. The lungs of PM-treated mice showed increased expression of EMT-related proteins, significant blood cell infiltration, and alveolar wall thickening. PFD treatment significantly improved these conditions and reduced collagen deposition. CONCLUSION: PM induces increased mitochondrial fission and incomplete autophagy (characterized by autophagosome accumulation and impaired flux), leading to EMT. PFD treatment can also effectively reduce PM-induced EMT formation by modulating these pathways.

papers.title_zh: 危重烧伤患者钠代谢紊乱的发生率、发生时机及与肾脏结局的关联：1758例单中心回顾性队列（高钠血症与MAKE独立相关，低钠血症无关联）
papers.title_en: Dysnatremia in critically ill burn patients: incidence, timing and association with kidney outcomes.
papers.authors: Kociolek M, Bellas Z, Walter T, Alexandru C, Maxime C, Emmanuel D, Lucie G, Maïté C et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Anaesthesiology, CriticalCare Medicine and Burn Unit, AP-HP, Saint-Louis Hospital, DMU Parabol, FHU PROMIC…
papers.results: 钠代谢紊乱发生率56.3%（n=990），低钠血症50.5%（n=888），高钠血症23.8%（n=418）；ICU出院时MAKE：低钠组vs正常血钠组12.6% vs 10.9%，p=0.304；高钠组vs无高钠组32.3% vs 5.4%，p<0.001；校正年龄与烧伤总面积后，高钠血症与ICU出院时MAKE独立相关（aHR 4.03；95%CI 2.92–5.56；p<0.001），低钠血症无关联（aHR 1.15；95%CI 0.85–1.55；p=0.377）；聚类分析识别3种表型：Cluster B（重度烧伤、结局最差）、Cluster A（高龄、以低钠为主、结局居中）、Cluster C（年轻、轻度烧伤、结局最佳）。
papers.authors_conclusion: 钠代谢紊乱影响超过半数烧伤患者；钠紊乱应被视为全身严重程度的标志物，值得密切监测并采取预防策略。
papers.ai_note: 主要终点为描述性发生率，肾脏结局均为次要终点，结论却主要由次要终点的高钠血症aHR支撑，存在主次终点错位式强调；'六倍升高'为未校正比较，校正模型仅纳入年龄与烧伤总面积，未含AKI分期、液体复苏量、吸入性损伤、机械通气、利尿剂/高渗盐使用等关键混杂，残余混杂风险高；MAKE定义与ICU出院时评估时点未在摘要中给出，血钠与肾损伤的时间先后无法判断，因果方向不明；聚类分析为探索性，未报告聚类方法稳定性指标；摘要未给出低钠血症与高钠血症重叠（同一患者兼具）的处理方式，可能影响组间比较的独立性。

pico.p: 法国某烧伤中心2011–2023年收治的1758例烧伤ICU患者（单中心回顾性队列）
pico.ic: 暴露：ICU住院期间至少一次低钠血症（<135 mmol/L）或高钠血症（>145 mmol/L）；对照：血钠正常患者；无干预措施

papers.reason: 为烧伤危重症中电解质紊乱的肾脏预后价值提供了大样本基线发生率与风险分层线索（高钠血症信号强、低钠血症为阴性），可作ICU电解质-肾结局研究方向的方法学对照；但与胸部肿瘤/胸外科诊疗决策无直接关联，仅对胸科围术期合并烧伤或危重患者的钠紊乱监测有间接参考价值。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Dysnatremia is common in critically ill patients and has been linked to poor outcomes and renal prognosis. Burn patients are particularly vulnerable, but the prognostic significance of dysnatremia in this population remains unclear. METHODS: We conducted a single-center retrospective cohort study of 1,758 burn patients admitted to a French burn center between 2011 and 2023. Dysnatremia was defined as at least one episode of hyponatremia (<135 mmol/L) or hypernatremia (>145 mmol/L) during intensive care unit (ICU) stay. The primary endpoint was the incidence of dysnatremia; secondary endpoints included major adverse kidney events (MAKE) at ICU discharge and acute kidney injury (AKI) occurrence and severity. RESULTS: Dysnatremia occurred in 56.3% of patients (n = 990), with hyponatremia in 50.5% (n = 888) and hypernatremia in 23.8% (n = 418). MAKE at ICU discharge did not differ between hyponatremic and normonatremic patients (12.6% vs. 10.9%, p = 0.304) but was sixfold higher with hypernatremia (32.3% vs. 5.4%, p < 0.001). After adjustment for age and burned total body surface area, hypernatremia was independently associated with MAKE at ICU discharge (adjusted hazard ratio [aHR] 4.03; 95% confidence interval [CI]: 2.92-5.56; p < 0.001), whereas hyponatremia was not (aHR 1.15; 95% CI: 0.85-1.55; p = 0.377). Clustering analysis identified three phenotypes: Cluster B (severe burns, worst outcomes), Cluster A (older patients, mostly hyponatremic, intermediate outcomes), and Cluster C (younger patients, mild burns, best outcomes). CONCLUSION: Dysnatremia affects over half of burn patients. Sodium disturbances should be viewed as markers of systemic severity, warranting close monitoring and preventive strategies.

papers.abstract_en: Men occupy a privileged position within gender power relations: the male body has been the default reference point for biomedical research and therapeutic development (with the historical exclusion of women from medical trials), and men dominate health services leadership and exercise well documented medical misogyny. Yet despite their privileged position, many aspects of men's health outcomes are neglected and undertheorised because they are not examined through an intersectional gender lens. Although consideration of gender and masculinity is important for understanding men's health, research thus far has focused predominantly on men's harmful health behaviours, overemphasising individual determinants of health, and a deficit-based approach. Little attention has been paid to the influence of structural determinants of men's health risks and vulnerabilities, or the gender-specific health outcomes of worsening social and economic inequalities. In this first paper of a Lancet Series on men's health, we present a conceptual framework for understanding men's health from an intersectional perspective, highlighting how structural, social, and commercial determinants of health, intersectionality, and syndemic theory can be combined to analyse men's health at different socioecological levels. We illustrate the framework using four selected case studies that show how the health outcomes of marginalised men are influenced by complex interactions. We provide a working definition of men's health that reflects existing literature and builds on the conceptual framework and case studies. Promotion of gender justice and health equity requires moving beyond one-dimensional approaches that construct men as problematic individuals, and towards better understanding and action on the broader set of power systems and structural determinants underpinning men's health.

papers.abstract_en: High-performance room-temperature CO2 sensors are essential for noninvasive clinical diagnostics, yet achieving high sensitivity in metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) remains challenging due to restricted ionic conduction. Building upon our previous expertise in guest-ion-source assembly, a strategy is proposed to enhance ionic conductivity by constructing long-range order and stable hydrogen-bonding (H-bonding) networks via chiral molecular incorporation. D-Tryptophan (D-Trp) and L-tryptophan (L-Trp) were encapsulated within γ-CD-MOF cavities to serve as chiral ion sources, facilitating the creation of bioinspired anion channels. The results reveal that the superior sensing performance of γ-CD-MOF@D-Trp is attributed to host-guest chiral preference. D‑Trp achieves ordered molecular arrangement via steric hindrance regulation, constructing long‑range order H‑bonding networks to optimize ion hopping pathways and stable sensing channels. The resulting sensor achieves a high response (2.10 toward 1000 ppm CO2), a low practical limit of detection (pLOD) of 10 ppm, and good selectivity. In particular, this work presents superior stability among MOF‑based room-temperature chemiresistive CO2 sensors reported so far, still retaining approximately 90% of its initial value after 35 days. Crucially, the fabricated γ-CD-MOFs@D-Trp-based sensor is preliminarily capable of distinguishing the differences in exhaled CO2 concentration between healthy individuals and lung cancer patients.

papers.abstract_en: Despite significant advances in ex vivo machine perfusion and innovation in graft modulation, successful translation of preclinical research into clinical practice is limited by the lack of multi-disciplinary exchange early in the research pipeline. LifeLUNG is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network funded by the European Union that aims to improve long-term outcomes in lung transplantation by leveraging ex vivo lung perfusion platforms to genetically modify donor lungs to modulate immune responses, reduce injury, and prevent graft rejection. LifeLUNG introduces an ELSA-IE approach, integrating Ethical, Legal, and Social Aspects research, Implementation science, and health Economics with preclinical research to navigate translational uncertainties and reduce the risk of late-stage innovation failure. By fostering the continuous exchange of insights and challenges among researchers, patients, and health systems, LifeLUNG aims to accelerate the responsible and clinically viable translation of lung transplantation innovations.
